[[Mito HollyHock]] 0-2 [[Sagan Tosu]] (7 August 2002) | average attendance = 6,842{{R|att}} | prevseason = [[2001 J.League Division 2|2001]] | nextseason = [[2003 J.League Division 2|2003]] }} The '''2002 J.League Division 2 season''' was the 31st season of the second-tier club football in Japan and the 4th season since the establishment of [[J2 League|J.League Division 2]]. Starting this season, extra-time rule was abolished and the league adopted the traditional 3-1-0 points system. The twelve clubs competed in the quadruple round-robin format. The top two received promotion to the [[J1 League|J.League Division 1]]. A club receives 3 points for a win, 1 point for a tie, and 0 points for a loss. The clubs are ranked by points, and tie breakers are, in the following order: * Goal differential * Goals scored * Head-to-head results A draw would be conducted, if necessary. However, if two clubs are tied at the first place, both clubs will be declared as the champions.
